s0001: Estimating the value of products and quotients involving decimals by rounding the numbers to the nearest whole number

s0025: Identifying the linear trend in two data series on a graph and extending them to find when their values become equal
s0026: Find how much each series changes per year, then extend both series year by year from the last year shown (or divide the gap by the amount it shrinks each year).
s0027: The graph shows the number of boxes of green tea and black tea (in thousands of boxes) sold by a tea-packing company over four years. If sales keep changing in the same way, in which year will green tea sales equal black tea sales?

s0036: The gap shrinks by $10 - 4 = 6$ each year

s0039: Thirty divided by six is five years, which means 2027.
s0040: Let's check: in 2027, both are at ninety thousand boxes.
